verdict: GBP engagement surged, but web traffic is contracting and paid ads remain off.
narrative: This period, your business ran entirely on organic activity — paid advertising on Meta and Google has been inactive for the full 28 days, so there are no paid leads to report. Your Google Business Profile was the standout, generating 29 actions (2 calls, 16 direction requests, 11 website clicks) across 25 days with local search visibility, and engagement spiked 150% in the most recent 7 days compared to the prior week. However, website sessions and search clicks each dropped roughly 41% in the last 7 days, and the GBP activity that drove that spike has quieted over the past four days, so the momentum has not yet held. Conversion tracking is being repaired, so the zero-conversion figure in website analytics under-reports actual inquiry activity. The priority this coming week is shoring up web traffic and determining the path back to paid activation so lead generation has a reliable channel.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions this period — calls, direction requests, and website clicks from local search
spike in GBP engagement over the past 7 days compared to the prior 7 days
drop in website sessions and search clicks in the last 7 days — traffic is contracting

watch_item.issue: Web traffic is declining sharply and paid advertising remains inactive, leaving lead generation with no reliable channel.
watch_item.fix: We are reviewing the path to reactivating paid campaigns and investigating the search traffic drop to stabilize inbound volume.
